_note: Simplified, generic component catalog for a research prototype. Not a product list. K-levels follow the Medicare Functional Classification Level scale (K0-K4).

components.name: SACH foot (solid ankle, cushion heel)
components.notes: Fixed ankle; shock absorption via heel cushion. Suitable for limited household ambulators.

components.name: Single-axis foot
components.notes: Plantarflexion at ankle improves knee stability in early stance; useful for transfemoral K1-K2.

components.name: Multi-axial foot
components.notes: Inversion/eversion accommodates uneven ground.

components.name: Energy-storing (dynamic response) carbon foot
components.notes: Carbon keel returns energy at push-off; for variable-cadence community ambulators.

components.name: Energy-storing carbon foot, heavy-duty
components.notes: Reinforced keel for users above 125 kg.

components.name: High-performance sport foot
components.notes: For K4 users with high-impact activities.

components.name: Manual-locking knee
components.notes: Locked in extension during gait; maximum stability, no swing-phase flexion.

components.name: Weight-activated stance-control knee
components.notes: Brakes under load; single-speed walkers.

components.name: Polycentric (4-bar) knee
components.notes: Instantaneous centre of rotation gives stance stability and better toe clearance; good for long residual limbs / knee disarticulation.

components.name: Hydraulic swing-and-stance knee
components.notes: Fluid control adapts to walking speed.

components.name: Microprocessor-controlled knee (MPK)
components.notes: Sensor-controlled resistance; stumble recovery, stairs/ramps. Reimbursement typically requires K3+ and demonstrated need. Requires charging and cognitive ability to manage the device.

components.name: Microprocessor knee, heavy-duty
components.notes: MPK rated to 150 kg.

components.name: Silicone liner with distal pin
components.notes: Pairs with shuttle lock. Distal pin can increase distal-end loading on very short limbs.

components.name: Seal-in liner (suction)
components.notes: Membrane seal for suction suspension; needs stable limb volume.

components.name: Cushion gel liner (with sleeve)
components.notes: Extra cushioning for sensitive or scarred skin; used with a suspension sleeve.

components.name: Shuttle lock (pin-lock)
components.notes: Simple, robust, easy to don; some pistoning.

components.name: Suction with one-way valve
components.notes: Better limb control than pin-lock; needs stable volume and dexterity to don.

components.name: Elevated vacuum
components.notes: Active pump maintains negative pressure; best limb-volume stability; more maintenance.

components.name: Suspension sleeve
components.notes: Elastomer sleeve over socket brim; adds suspension for short limbs or as auxiliary.

components.name: TES belt / lanyard (auxiliary)
components.notes: Auxiliary suspension for short transfemoral limbs or when primary suspension is insufficient.

components.name: PTB (patellar tendon bearing) socket
components.notes: Load on patellar tendon and tibial flares; classic transtibial design.

components.name: Total surface bearing socket
components.notes: Even load distribution with gel liner; preferred for sensitive or scarred skin.

components.name: Ischial containment socket
components.notes: Contains ischial tuberosity for medio-lateral stability; standard transfemoral design.

components.name: Sub-ischial socket
components.notes: Brim below ischium; comfort for active users with good limb length and musculature.

components.name: Carbon-fibre dynamic AFO (posterior leaf)
components.notes: For flaccid drop foot without significant spasticity or instability; lightweight, energy return.

components.name: Solid-ankle thermoplastic AFO
components.notes: Rigid ankle; controls spasticity and medio-lateral instability.

components.name: Hinged thermoplastic AFO with plantarflexion stop
components.notes: Allows dorsiflexion for stairs/sit-to-stand; needs adequate calf control.

components.name: Stance-control KAFO
components.notes: Locks knee in stance, frees in swing; for quadriceps weakness with adequate hip strength.

components.name: Locked-knee KAFO (drop lock)
components.notes: Knee locked in extension during gait.
